name: Potion of Monster Energy
description:
A creature may spend a half action to drink the contents of the vial. If they do, for the next hour, they take +3d to each of their Strength, Dexterity and Fortitude rolls, and -3d to all other skill checks. During the hour, if the creature goes one minute without significant physical exertion, roll a d4:

  • 1 - It makes a melee attack against the nearest creature.

  • 2 - It take the Sprint action, running in a random direction.

  • 3 - It makes a melee attack against itself.

  • 4 - It screams as loud as it possibly can.

At the end of the hour, the creature's Endurance is halved, it takes 1 Shadow, and it checks 3 Conditions.
